title: Keep VCF Automation project reads live across credential rotation
prompt:
Implement the single-file `VcfAutomationClient.java` client against the protected VCF Automation 9.1 wire contract in `docs/contract.json`. The contract was derived from the Broadcom xAPIs reference pages recorded in `docs/official_sources.json`; it is reference documentation, not a published API specification. Use only the JDK (no Maven or external jars).

Keep the supplied public surface exactly:
- `VcfAutomationClient(URI baseUri, String authorization)`
- `void rotateCredential(String authorization)`
- `List<VcfAutomationClient.Project> listProjects()`
- nested record `Project(String id, String name, String description)`

`listProjects()` must call the contract's `Get All Projects` operation with `apiVersion=2019-01-15`, `Accept: application/json`, and the current value as the complete `Authorization` header. Decode the page's `content` array and return every project sorted by `name` ascending and then `id` ascending, independent of server element order.

Credential rotation is concurrent. Each request attempt must use one coherent credential generation. If an attempt receives HTTP 401 after that generation has been superseded by `rotateCredential`, retry the operation with the current generation so requests already in flight are not stranded on the old credential. Do not impose a fixed retry count: continue only across observed generation changes. A 401 for the still-current generation, or any other non-2xx response, must fail with `IOException`. Preserve `InterruptedException` from the JDK HTTP call.

`TestMain.java` is the protected acceptance harness. It runs a contract-pinned loopback mock only; no live VMware endpoint or credentials are used. Do not modify `TestMain.java` or anything under `docs/`. Run `java TestMain.java`.
